d._instruction: Rinse the foam off with the shower.
Pick a colour for her feathers.
Scrub the foam all over her.
Put the patches on her eyes.
Spray the polish on her beak.
Dry her wet feathers with the dryer.
Fill the cracks in her beak.
Spread the clay mask over her face.
Pick a face paint for her.
Trim the messy feathers with the scissors.
Buff her beak until it shines.
Wipe the dried mask off with a tissue.

377.n: 6 - Scrape the dirt off her beak

d._instruction: Scrape the dirt off her beak.
Brush the shade over her eyelids.
Take the face wash to her face.
Spray the colour over her feathers.
